findings: 135 generic native power calls in 121 moves / 83 monsters; 96 literal amounts, 132 recognized recipients, every power ID resolves. Prior graphs/references/card effects and assembly hash unchanged.
The Obscura SAIL declares Strength 3 to self and allies per invocation. Guards, loops, modifiers and final stacks remain unsimulated; non-generic and helper-method calls are not covered.
Compact observed combat progress retains native capped HP damage and confirmed zero-HP transitions without restoring old raw history or claiming permanent removal.

Turn 4 changed from Taunt leader then Perfected Strike phantom to Perfected Strike phantom then Strike leader. This trades a setup effect for current damage; changed selection alone is not proven improvement.

Initial turn 7 replay skipped comparisons due to a raw-size estimate despite compact requests fitting. Removed that estimate; all actual requests still enforce the compiled 90000-byte limit. Coverage now distinguishes eligible, assessed and pairwise-compared plans.

Final turn 7 replay assessed 73 plans and compared 5 finalists in both orders; it still commits both attacks to the phantom. Five of ten balanced pairs disagree by presentation order. Long-horizon target choice and model stability remain unresolved.
